story.text: 승객 여러분, 이번엔 귀로 즐기는 우리 소리 여행이에요. 전라도는 판소리의 고향이랍니다.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, i-beon-en gwi-ro jeul-gi-neun u-ri so-ri yeo-haeng-i-e-yo. jeol-la-do-neun pan-so-ri-ui go-hyang-i-ram-ni-da.
story.en: Passengers, this time it's a journey of our sound to enjoy with your ears. Jeolla-do is the home of pansori.

story.text: '판소리'는 한 사람이 소리와 이야기, 몸짓으로 긴 이야기를 풀어내는 우리 전통 공연이에요.
story.reading: pan-so-ri-neun han sa-ram-i so-ri-wa i-ya-gi, mom-jis-eu-ro gin i-ya-gi-reul pul-eo-nae-neun u-ri jeon-tong gong-yeon-i-e-yo.
story.en: 'Pansori' is our traditional performance where one person unfolds a long story through voice, narration, and gesture.

story.text: 그 이야기를 들려주는 사람을 '소리꾼'이라고 해요. 춘향가, 흥보가 같은 이야기를 목청껏 노래한답니다.
story.reading: geu i-ya-gi-reul deul-lyeo-ju-neun sa-ram-eul so-ri-kkun-i-ra-go hae-yo. chun-hyang-ga, heung-bo-ga gat-eun i-ya-gi-reul mok-cheong-kkeot no-rae-han-dam-ni-da.
story.en: The person who tells that story is called a 'sorikkun' (singer). They sing stories like Chunhyangga and Heungboga at the top of their voice.

story.text: 소리꾼 옆에는 '고수'가 앉아요. 북을 치며 소리꾼과 숨결을 맞추는 든든한 짝꿍이지요.
story.reading: so-ri-kkun yeop-e-neun go-su-ga anj-a-yo. bug-eul chi-myeo so-ri-kkun-gwa sum-gyeol-eul mat-chu-neun deun-deun-han jjak-kkung-i-ji-yo.
story.en: A 'gosu' (drummer) sits next to the singer. They're a reliable partner who beats the drum in rhythm with the singer's breath.

story.text: 고수가 치는 악기가 바로 '북'이에요. 북 장단에 맞춰 소리꾼의 노래가 힘을 얻는답니다.
story.reading: go-su-ga chi-neun ak-gi-ga ba-ro bug-i-e-yo. buk jang-dan-e mat-chwo so-ri-kkun-ui no-rae-ga him-eul eod-neun-dam-ni-da.
story.en: The instrument the drummer plays is the 'buk' (drum). Matched to the drumbeat, the singer's song gains power.

story.text: 관객들도 가만히 있지 않아요. '얼쑤', '좋다' 같은 '추임새'로 흥을 함께 나누지요.
story.reading: gwan-gaek-deul-do ga-man-hi it-ji an-a-yo. eol-ssu, joh-da gat-eun chu-im-sae-ro heung-eul ham-kke na-nu-ji-yo.
story.en: The audience doesn't just sit still either. They share the excitement with 'chuimsae' (encouraging shouts) like 'eolssu' and 'jota'.

story.text: 자, 우리 소리의 매력을 다섯 단어로 느껴 보셨나요? 이제 문제를 풀며 귀와 마음을 열어봐요!
story.reading: ja, u-ri so-ri-ui mae-ryeog-eul da-seot dan-eo-ro neu-kkyeo bo-syeot-na-yo? i-je mun-je-reul pul-myeo gwi-wa ma-eum-eul yeol-eo-bwa-yo!
story.en: Now, did you feel the charm of our sound through five words? Let's open our ears and hearts by solving some questions!

words.example_en: Pansori combines voice and storytelling together.
The singer tells the story through song.
You sing along to the beat of the drum.
The drummer plays the drum to lift the mood.
Supportive shouts add to the excitement.

sentences.en: Pansori is a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.
The singer sings with all their voice.
The drum matches its breath with the singer.
The drummer sits next to the singer.
The supportive shouts create an exciting mood.
